results.result:
The fix and test are in place, but I could not run the tests. Every pnpm command was denied by the permission gate, and this session has no one to approve it.

**What I changed**

- `src/duration.ts`: the `h` case now multiplies by 3,600,000 instead of 60,000, so `"2h"` returns two hours in milliseconds rather than two minutes.
- `tests/duration.test.ts`: added an hours case covering `1h`, `2h`, and the fractional `0.5h`. I first wrote a new file under `src/`, then noticed the vitest config only picks up `tests/**`, so I deleted that file and extended the existing suite instead.

**What did not run**

I tried three commands and each was blocked with "This command requires approval":

```
pnpm exec vitest run tests/duration.test.ts
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
```

Per the project working agreement I did not work around the block. The gate has not passed in this session, so the change is unverified. To confirm, run the single test file and typecheck above, or the full `pnpm test`. The fix is a one-constant change and the new assertions are straightforward, so I expect them to pass, but that is an expectation and not a result.
